new_scholarship.name: International Undergraduate Entrance Scholarships
new_scholarship.duration: Up to 4 years, renewable on annual average
new_scholarship.application_period: Considered automatically with the admission application for the 2027-2028 entry year. No separate scholarship application, and no published scholarship application deadline.
new_scholarship.application_method: Automatic - no separate scholarship application required
new_scholarship.description: Lakehead University awards entrance scholarships to top international students entering a bachelor's programme, on a tiered grid set by admission average. Consideration is automatic: the offer is included in the Letter of Acceptance, so there is no separate application and no separate deadline.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Non-Canadian citizens entering Lakehead directly from high school, or transferring from an international college or university, who hold a strong admission average.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Non-Canadian citizens entering Years 1, 2 or 3 of a minimum four-year undergraduate degree programme, ranked by admission average. Award is automatic on admission; no separate application.
eligibility: Entering Lakehead University from a high school, or transferring from an international college or university
Entering Year 1, 2 or 3 of a minimum four-year undergraduate degree programme
Admission average of 90.0%+ (Canadian equivalent) for the $40,000 tier
Admission average of 80.0%-89.9% (Canadian equivalent) for the $30,000 tier
Admission average of 75.0%-79.9% (Canadian equivalent) for the $6,000 tier
No separate scholarship application - consideration is automatic with admission
coverage: Tuition for a bachelor's degree programme
Up to four academic years or until the first degree is awarded, whichever occurs first
Renewable at $10,000/year (90% tier) or $7,500/year (80% tier) subject to annual average
benefits: $40,000 total ($10,000 x 4 years) for a 90.0%+ admission average
$30,000 total ($7,500 x 4 years) for an 80.0%-89.9% admission average
$6,000 one-time (Year 1 only) for a 75.0%-79.9% admission average
requirements: Meet the admission average for the applicable tier
Enrol in a minimum four-year undergraduate degree programme
Maintain the renewal average each academic year for renewable tiers
new_scholarship.selection_notes: Ranking is by admission average only. Offers appear in the Letter of Acceptance. Scholarships at each tier are unlimited in number.
new_scholarship.notes: Values, eligibility and criteria are published as subject to change without notice. The award cannot be applied to Academic English Program costs; it is applied to first-year tuition after the Academic English Program is completed.

programme_detail_official.deadline_central_display: No published scholarship deadline - consideration is automatic with the admission application
programme_detail_official.deadline_note: The award is considered automatically with admission and the offer is included in the Letter of Acceptance. No separate scholarship deadline is published. Admission deadlines are separate and are not published on this page.
programme_detail_official.status_note: The 2027-2028 scholarship grid is published and open for the coming entry year. No closing date for consideration is published because the award is automatic on admission.
programme_detail_official.funding_duration: Maximum 4 academic years or until the first degree is awarded, whichever occurs first
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: Applied to first-year tuition for an undergraduate degree programme, after successful completion of the Academic English Program. Not applicable to Academic English Program costs.
programme_detail_official.funding_label: Tiered entrance scholarship, $6,000 to $40,000 total over the award term
benefits: 90.0%+ admission average: $40,000 total ($10,000 x 4 years), renewable provided a 90% average is achieved in each academic year
80.0%-89.9% admission average: $30,000 total ($7,500 x 4 years), renewable provided an 80% average is achieved in each academic year
75.0%-79.9% admission average: $6,000 one-time, awarded in Year 1 only, non-renewable
Scholarships available: unlimited at every tier
If a recipient's average falls between 80.0% and 89.9%, the scholarship is amended to $7,500 CAD/year for each subsequent academic year of the remaining term
Recipients whose status changes and who may be charged domestic fees have the value reassessed against the domestic entrance scholarship grid then in force
eligibility: Non-Canadian citizens entering Lakehead University from a high school
OR students transferring from an international college or university
Entering Years 1, 2 or 3 of a minimum four-year undergraduate degree programme
Ranked on the Canadian equivalent of the average used for admission consideration
IB average is stated alongside the Canadian equivalent: 35+ for the top tier, 30-34 for the second, 28-29 for the third
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Open to non-Canadian citizens entering from a high school or transferring from an international institution. Canadian citizens and permanent residents are not eligible for the international grid.
programme_detail_official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open to all undergraduate degree programmes; no subject restriction published
programme_detail_official.application_route: Awarded automatically; the scholarship offer is included in the student's Letter of Acceptance
requirements: Meet the admission average for the applicable tier
Enrol full-time in a minimum four-year undergraduate degree programme
Achieve the renewal average in each subsequent academic year for renewable tiers
Complete the Academic English Program before the scholarship is applied to tuition
programme_detail_official.english_requirement_note: Not published on the scholarship page. Lakehead runs an Academic English Program, and the scholarship is applied to first-year tuition only after that program is completed, which implies an English-language readiness step but publishes no score requirement.
selection_criteria: Automatic consideration - no separate application or additional assessment published
programme_detail_official.duration: Up to 4 academic years or until first degree award
award_holder_conditions: Renewal at the 90% tier requires a 90% university average in each academic year
Renewal at the 80% tier requires an 80% university average in each academic year
The $6,000 tier is non-renewable and paid in Year 1 only
Maximum scholarship term is 4 academic years or until the first degree is awarded
Scholarship value is reassessed if the recipient's status changes such that domestic fees apply
supplements_or_initiatives: Separate International Graduate Scholarships and Graduate Assistantships exist at Lakehead but are out of scope for this bachelor's record

programme_detail_official.description: Lakehead University offers tiered entrance scholarships to international undergraduates, with awards up to $40,000 over four years. Consideration is automatic on admission and the offer is carried in the Letter of Acceptance, so there is no separate scholarship application.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Tuition only; not living costs, not travel

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to an undergraduate degree programme at Lakehead - the scholarship needs no separate application
Meet the admission average for the target tier (90.0%+, 80.0%-89.9% or 75.0%-79.9% Canadian equivalent)
Enter as Year 1, 2 or 3 of a minimum four-year undergraduate degree programme
Be a non-Canadian citizen entering from high school or transferring from an international institution
Check the Letter of Acceptance for the scholarship offer, which is where the award appears
Plan for the Academic English Program - the scholarship applies to first-year tuition only after it is completed
common_rejection_risks: Canadian citizen or permanent resident - the international grid does not apply
Entering a programme shorter than four years, or entering Year 4
Admission average below 75.0% - below the lowest published tier
Applying to Lakehead as a domestic student, which routes to the domestic entrance grid instead
Failing to maintain the renewal average, which reduces a 90% tier award to $7,500/year
estimated_uncovered_costs: Academic English Program fees - the scholarship explicitly cannot be applied to these
Second-year and later tuition at the $6,000 tier, which is Year 1 only
Provincial health insurance and other mandatory fees not listed in the scholarship grid
document_audit: No separate scholarship application documents are published
Academic English Program placement is required before the scholarship can be applied to tuition
No published document checklist exists on the scholarship page

alerts.message: The award is automatic with admission, so there is no scholarship deadline to meet. The admission deadline is what matters.

alerts.trigger: 2027-2028 grid open at time of verification
alerts.message: The published grid was open when checked on 2026-10-03, and no close date is published.
Lakehead states all scholarship values, eligibility requirements and criteria are subject to change without notice.
Only tier thresholds are published. An average below 75.0% falls outside every published tier, so awards are unlimited but not guaranteed.

alerts.trigger: Status change to domestic fee payer
alerts.message: If the recipient's status changes such that domestic fees apply, the award is reassessed against the domestic entrance grid and may be reduced.
The scholarship cannot be applied to Academic English Program costs; it is applied to first-year undergraduate tuition only after that program is completed.
A 90% tier recipient who falls to an 80.0%-89.9% average has the award amended to $7,500 CAD per year for the remaining term.

submission_workflow: Choose a Lakehead undergraduate degree programme
Submit the admission application with the required admission average
No separate scholarship submission is made
Receive the Letter of Acceptance containing the scholarship offer and tier
Complete the Academic English Program if required
Scholarship is applied to first-year undergraduate tuition
